New: Bolt group key in Seed43 Properties: the plate and holes to scale with pitch (p), gauge (g) and edge distances (ex, ey); the rows use the same letters
Guides: an animated card shows how to place or edit each kind of element (member, section or fixing, bolt group, bracing line), with Don't show this again
Selecting a Seed43 element with Seed43 Properties closed: a card says it has properties and Open properties opens the drawer
Tips button on the Seed43 tab to show or hide the guides and the properties card
Bracing line: Space flips the line and tag to the other side, while placing and when selected
General: Scale shown as the sheet's ratio, e.g. 1:100 (sheet), using the page scale from Open PDF Studio where it is set
Guides show again on every new selection until switched off

New: Elements tab in the Seed43 drawer: type a name or size, pick and place without opening the Element Library; your 20 most used elements show when the search is empty
Change element: swap a selected section or member for another size or category, keeping its place, rotation, view and scale
Switch a section to an elevation or plan member and back
Timber side by side: 2, 3, 4 or more pieces (2/140x45), and your own label text such as DS
Line at: a member drawn on its centre line or on an edge (top of steel, one face); J switches it while placing
Enter on a selected element places another the same (Create Similar)
Several Seed43 elements selected: one shared form for scale, label, rotation, view, line and pieces (needs an Open PDF Studio build with onSelectionChange)
Dimension key in Seed43 Properties: the section to scale with d, b, tf, tw, t and r1 marked
General: Section data with names and units, in Dimensions and Section properties
Snapping to section corners and side midpoints and member edges; Shift or Ctrl locks the direction (Tab turns it) and still snaps
Fixings drawn in purple, apart from steel, timber and bolt groups
The Seed43 drawer no longer passes clicks, scrolling or typing through to the page

New: Seed43 Properties: a drawer on the right of the page view, opened with its tab, showing the selected member, section, bolt group, bracing line or smart stamp as a Property / Value table with foldable sections. Works with the app's Properties panel closed; the Properties button on the Seed43 tab switches it off
Element Library: Countries list to choose which countries load, and drag grips to set their order
General: Bracing lines can be selected by their tag text as well as the line
Seed43 windows (the Smart Stamps window in the official app) float or dock on any side of the page view and stack
Seed43 styles refresh after a reinstall without restarting the app

New: South Africa in the Element Library: SAISC I, IPE, H, PFC, angles, CHS, SHS, RHS, lipped channels and zeds, SA Pine S5 and S7, glulam, MiTek SA truss and strap hangers (estimated heights), bolts

United Kingdom in the Element Library: UB, UC, PFC, angles, hot-finished SHS, RHS and CHS, C16 and C24 sawn, CLS, GL24h and GL28c glulam, Kerto-S LVL, JJI-Joists, Simpson Strong-Tie SAE and JHA hangers, angle brackets and restraint straps, bolts

Bolt groups in elevation and plan: head, plies, washer, nut and thread side on with the bolt length from the grip, or looking down on the heads; bolt or threaded rod, no nut, one, two or double nuts, round, square or no washers, and a switch to turn the bolt over. Face, Plan and Elevation buttons in the Element Library
General: Request a library asks for links to the data (product pages, catalogues, size tables)
Smart Stamps opens as a dockable app palette where the app supports it (docks on all four sides, stacks with other palettes); floating, it shows each family's icon and name

New: About: version, update check, what changed and which Seed43 tools show on the ribbon
Australia in the Element Library: steel, Lysaght Zeds and Cees, MGP10/MGP12, F17 hardwood, Meyer, Wesbeam and Hyne timber, MiTek and Pryda hangers, bolts
Bracing: a bracing legend line along a braced wall with its type and length in metres, like the Revit Bracing Legend Tag
Fixings: Lumberlok joist, LVL, I-beam and split hangers, Tylok and Nailon plates, angles and cleats, galvanised and stainless, drawn to scale in section or elevation
Timber from the supplier tables: SG8, hySPAN, hy90, hyONE, hyCHORD, hyJOIST, Prolam PL8 and PL12 beams, posts and PLX
Timber section looks: glulam laminations, LVL veneer lines, sawn timber cross or blocking diagonal
Members are placed like a line: click A, then B; Ctrl or Shift keeps them square
Snapping to member ends, midpoints and centres; grips to stretch and move
General: Element Library window redesigned: browse tree under New Zealand, search, preview tiles or list, details panel
Browse groups fold up and open with a click, and start folded
Smart Stamps open their own panel where the app has no palette switch
Removed: The unused NZ gauge and base plate reference tables

New: Members from point A to point B in elevation or plan; any rotation; Space rotates
Element Library with NZ Steel: sections and bolt groups placed to scale
Smart Stamps: stamp families with shared parameters, a builder and placed-date defaults
